answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is locked before it can earn reputation, then slash that bond when independent audits catch coordinated duplicate identities. Auditors compare behavior and shared control signals, not just names, so a Sybil farm cannot escape by starting a fresh account. The rule makes an echo of copied accounts costly: an attacker must tie up real capital for every identity and risks losing it across the whole spiral of linked accounts. A gale of cheap registrations becomes expensive to sustain.
